programs.title: Garage Sale Mystery: The Deadly Room
programs.desc: Jennifer Shannon must use her intuitive skills to investigate her friend's death in a multimillion-dollar home with a dark history.

programs.title: Garage Sale Mystery: The Wedding Dress
programs.desc: Sleuth Jennifer Shannon (Lori Loughlin) and Detective Lynwood (Barclay Hope) investigate a decades-old case involving the disappearance of a groom.

programs.title: Garage Sale Mystery: Guilty Until Proven Innocent
programs.desc: Antiques guru Jennifer Shannon (Lori Loughlin) investigates a murder after an old college friend becomes the prime suspect.

programs.title: Garage Sale Mystery: The Novel Murders
programs.desc: Antiques expert Jennifer Shannon believes two items found at the scene of a murder are actually clues straight out of famous mystery stories.

programs.title: Garage Sale Mystery: The Art of Murder
programs.desc: Jennifer, a garage sale shopping expert with sharp observation skills, helps the local police department investigate crimes and solve mysteries. While arranging a charity garage sale event, Jennifer finds a body in the attic of a local residence. At first she thinks the cause of death was an accidental fall, but when she learns that the victim was trying to call 911, she begins to suspect foul play.

programs.title: Garage Sale Mystery: The Beach Murder
programs.desc: Jenn suspects foul play when the body of an avid surfer is found on an isolated beach, the victim of an apparent drowning.

programs.title: Garage Sale Mystery: Murder by Text
programs.desc: A concert rehearsal is stalled when the bass player dies from an apparent suicide. Jenn discovers that a stun gun was used to immobilize the victim before her death, but before Jenn can confront the weapon's owner, another band member is murdered.

programs.title: Garage Sale Mystery: Murder Most Medieval
programs.desc: Jennifer finds the body of a local college history professor hidden in a suit of armor she purchased. After the professor's teaching assistant becomes the next victim, Jennifer finds herself caught in a killer's web of dangerous lies.

programs.title: Garage Sale Mystery: A Case of Murder
programs.desc: After buying an old reel-to-reel recorder at a garage sale, Jenn discovers that it includes the sound of a man pleading for his life.

programs.title: Garage Sale Mysteries: The Pandora's Box Murders
programs.desc: When garage sale guru and amateur sleuth Jennifer Shannon agrees to appear on a reality TV series, she uncovers a puzzle box which may contain the key clue in a murder case.

programs.title: Garage Sale Mystery: The Mask Murder
programs.desc: When Jennifer buys a storage locker at auction, she discovers a dead body inside -- along with a mask matching the deceased woman.

programs.title: Garage Sale Mysteries: Picture a Murder
programs.desc: Jenn gets the photos in an antique camera from the estate of a recently deceased and seemingly wealthy photography enthusiast printed, and one of the pictures leads her to believe that the man's death was anything but accidental.
